Title: type(scope)!: Summary, under ~72 characters, e.g. "fix(bob): Pieces under 20 particles can be steered".
Types and scopes: studio/README.md#prs. It becomes the squash commit on main, and the pr-title check enforces it.
Keep every section short. Details go in the unit file, docs or a decision record; link them.
Delete sections that don't apply.
-->

**Why:** <!-- one or two lines; link the unit or issue -->

**Session:** <!-- link to studio/sessions/<date>-<HHMM>-<slug>.md, or "Session log: none, because …" (a /feedback session, a one-line fix) -->

**What:**
-

**Play:** <!-- scenario link, and what to look for -->

**Docs:** <!-- docs and studio files updated, or "none needed, because …". Without a unit change: "Unit: none, because …". The in-step check reads these. -->

**Health:** <!-- end-of-session `pnpm health` result, one line -->

**Next:** <!-- follow-ups, if any -->
